title: Enhancing the Thermostability of Sweet Protein Thaumatin II by Integrated Rational Design.
authors: Wang, Lefei; Yang, Yuxin; Dong, Jintong; Wang, Haoqi; Zhu, Zhengming; Jiang, Ling
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过整合理性设计（HotSpot Wizard、FoldX、PyRosetta）和分子动力学模拟，改造甜蛋白Thaumatin II的热稳定性，核心对象为蛋白质结构，问题涉及结构稳定性计算与设计，方法包含物理模拟和结构预测工具，但偏工程应用且非典型结构生成/采样问题，故评7分。
abstract: Thaumatin II is a high-intensity sweet protein whose limited thermostability restricts its industrial application. Using the previously evolved high-yield Thaumatin variant M-882 as the parental scaffold, we used an integrated rational design strategy combining HotSpot Wizard, FoldX, and PyRosetta. Candidate variants were evaluated by sfGFP-based fluorescence screening, SDS-PAGE, and absolute protein quantification. The variant R178H showed the most favorable overall balance of structural compatibility and thermal resilience. After heating at 80  degrees C for 2 h, R178H retained 63% of its soluble protein fraction, compared with 43% for M-882. Structural analysis suggested that replacing Arg178 with histidine reduced local steric hindrance and improved packing interactions. Molecular dynamics simulations further indicated that R178H adopted a more compact and stable conformation. These results clarify the structural basis for its improved heat resistance and provide a rational strategy for engineering thermostable sweet proteins for food-processing applications.
abstract_zh: Thaumatin II是一种高强度的甜味蛋白，其有限的热稳定性限制了其工业应用。利用先前进化出的高产Thaumatin变体M-882作为亲本支架，我们采用了结合HotSpot Wizard、FoldX和PyRosetta的综合理性设计策略。候选变体通过基于sfGFP的荧光筛选、SDS-PAGE和绝对蛋白定量进行评估。变体R178H在结构兼容性和热稳定性方面表现出最有利的整体平衡。在80°C加热2小时后，R178H保留了其可溶性蛋白部分的63%，而M-882为43%。结构分析表明，将Arg178替换为组氨酸减少了局部空间位阻并改善了堆积相互作用。分子动力学模拟进一步表明，R178H采用了更紧凑且更稳定的构象。这些结果阐明了其改善耐热性的结构基础，并为食品加工应用中工程化热稳定甜味蛋白提供了理性策略。
